class: Ambiguous body-text matching mistakes job responsibilities for a verification challenge
symptom: The Security Engineer posting was handed off as a CAPTCHA while no challenge was visible.
root_cause: The CAPTCHA text pattern matched the unbounded phrase security check anywhere in the body, including automating security checks in a job description.
why_tests_missed: CAPTCHA tests covered actual prompts and challenge frames but not ordinary job-description use of the same words.
fix: Keep explicit human-verification phrases and visible challenge frames; require ambiguous security-check wording to be a standalone visible prompt.
prevention: Test detection against both real challenge UI and ordinary employment/security descriptions; report the kind of evidence used.
